annotation.evidence_span: SHOULD send an MSS option in every SYN segment
annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations may choose to send the MSS option only when the receive MSS is different from the default.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations may choose to send the MSS option in every SYN segment, regardless of whether the receive MSS is different from the default.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' allows for implementations to either send the MSS option only when necessary or to always send it. This creates ambiguity as to the intended behaviour.
